roadmap.title: Theming: a real color picker + background color picker
roadmap.note: Mocked up (design/vortex-color-picker-mockup.html) -- accent + background-tint pickers with a live preview, 3 open design questions flagged in the mockup itself (override vs. new saved theme; one color vs. a light/dark pair; what "Reset" resets to). Not built, pending sign-off on those 3 questions.

roadmap.title: Minor: deep-link URL with a ?reports= sub-tab param can show the English page-title fallback briefly
roadmap.note: Found live 2026-08-15 verifying the Anvil's Mark/Shadowmarked rename, not caused by it -- a pre-existing Phase 2 timing gap. Loading e.g. ?theme=skyrim&area=reports&reports=workshop directly can call showReportsSubTab before theme.js's async fetch resolves, so the tab title/#headerMeta locks in the English fallback until the user navigates again. Low priority, cosmetic, self-corrects on any real navigation.

roadmap.title: Harmonization (Phase 3a): multi-select filter badges -- built 2026-08-15, pending live spot-check
roadmap.note: Every clickable filter badge app-wide (Missing Masters, Rebuild Missing Files, Rules Generator + its Report, Stats, Work Through, Merge Plugins, Rebuild Collection's Plan + log-view pages) converted from single-select-isolate to real multi-select (workspace UX-PRINCIPLES.md rule 7). Verified via synthetic data (no real problem data in the environment at build time) -- director confirmed Phase 3b (the cart bar) live 2026-08-15 but hasn't yet clicked through this half with real problem mods/masters. Worth a spot-check next time some exist.
